build: Default full-language features, Cargo dev profile; Linux only
method: Three repetitions, two competing SHA-256 processes, independent MCP search session; full indexing, a 16-file edit, then unchanged sync. CPU 100% is one core. Peak CPU/RSS are sampled; RSS sums process RSS and can double-count shared pages. files_per_s is indexed workload size divided by elapsed time, representing checked-file throughput for sync. Short operations can have missed peaks.
correctness: For each operation, node/edge identities and file-content hashes match original indexing across all profiles and repetitions.
summary_method: Each summary value is the median of three per-run values, including medians of per-run sampled peaks and per-run MCP p95 latencies.
revision_scope: Measurements predate merging upstream master d35937f. They compare the original revision with the CPU-profile implementation, not the current upstream-merged tip.
